title: Untoward effects associated with practolol administration: oculomucocutaneous syndrome
population: Case series of 27 patients with eye disease attributed to the beta-blocker practolol
funder: not read: the scanned article in PubMed Central was not retrieved, and the abstract carries no funding statement.
result: Keratoconjunctivitis sicca, conjunctival scarring, fibrosis, metaplasia and shrinkage developed in 27 patients as an adverse reaction to practolol; rashes, nasal and mucosal ulceration, fibrous or plastic peritonitis, pleurisy, cochlear damage and secretory otitis media also occurred in some. Three patients suffered profound visual loss. Symptoms and signs improved on withdrawal of the drug, but reduced tear secretion persisted in most patients.
